name: default-off private paged KV cache leaf
source_repository: original mlx2 implementation based on local codex/varlen-paged-attention revision 42783178c
license: original mlx2 project code; no third-party implementation copied
modifications: Added a private, token-major host byte cache with explicit append, generation-pinned attention plan, and exact logical export; refuses segmented composition until an explicit paged consumer exists. Ordinary KVCache.update_and_fetch is unchanged.
validation: CPU-only fake-backend tests for default-off refusal, capacity and payload preflight, 63/64 page boundary writes, completion-gated publication, generation lease lifetime, failed writes, and segmented refusal.
limitations: Host byte payloads are a CPU contract and are not an MLX native write integration. AttentionUse needs an external terminal proof; there is no model adapter, read/write ordering proof, APCv2 handoff, serving route, GPU qualification, or observed use.
